AnomalyOut.title: AnomalyOut
AnomalyOut.description:
One derived anomaly shown in the web /anomalies screen.

`amount` is a signed FCFA gap (closing) or a negative quantity delta (stock)
or a price deviation — the exact meaning depends on `kind`.

AuditLogOut.title: AuditLogOut
AuditLogOut.description: Une ligne du journal : qui a fait quoi, quand — et sur quel objet.

BusinessHealthStatus.title: BusinessHealthStatus
BusinessHealthStatus.description:
« healthy » / « a_surveiller » / « a_risque » — computed from configurable, measurable
rules (days without activity, blocked sync, failed payment), never an arbitrary score.
`reasons` says which rule fired so the team can act (cahier Super Admin §8).

CustomerDetailOut.title: CustomerDetailOut
CustomerDetailOut.description: Full view: balance + ordered transaction history.

CustomerTransactionOut.title: CustomerTransactionOut
CustomerTransactionOut.description: One line of a customer's history: a credit sale or a repayment.

DailyClosingIn.title: DailyClosingIn
DailyClosingIn.description:
No `expected_cash`/`expected_momo` here on purpose: they are computed
server-side from recorded money movements, never trusted from the client —
see documentation/SYNC_DESIGN.md.

ManualMoneyMovementType.title: ManualMoneyMovementType
ManualMoneyMovementType.description:
Excludes "sale" and "credit_repayment": those are only ever derived
server-side from a Sale / CreditRepaymentIn event.

ManualStockMovementType.title: ManualStockMovementType
ManualStockMovementType.description: Excludes "sale": that type is only ever derived server-side from a Sale event.

ProductOut.title: ProductOut
ProductOut.description: Full view — owners, or employees with can_view_purchase_prices.

ProductOutRestricted.title: ProductOutRestricted
ProductOutRestricted.description: What a regular employee sees: no purchase price, no margin visible.

RecoverCodeRequest.title: RecoverCodeRequest
RecoverCodeRequest.description:
Récupération du code entreprise, sans être connecté (nouvel appareil, code perdu).
Le code seul ne permet aucune action — la connexion exige toujours le PIN — donc une
vérification d'identité légère suffit : nom de l'entreprise + nom du propriétaire +
téléphone du propriétaire, tous les trois obligatoires.

RelatedOperationOut.title: RelatedOperationOut
RelatedOperationOut.description: One operation that contributed to an anomaly (drill-down "historique d'un écart").

ShiftIn.title: ShiftIn
ShiftIn.description:
Opening and closing of one work session, idempotent on client_uuid: the first push
creates the shift (opened_at + opening_cash); a later push with closed_at + counted_cash
closes it. expected_cash / difference are computed server-side, never trusted.

UpdateEmployeeRequest.title: UpdateEmployeeRequest
UpdateEmployeeRequest.description:
Édition/désactivation d'un employé. Pas de `role` (immuable — voir
auth_service.update_employee) et pas de `pin` (le PIN employé est créé une
fois à sa création, on ne le réédite pas dans le MVP).
